reviews.comment: Swagnik is a tough professor, but truly has a heart for his students. He gave extra credit when necessary but still harsh on grading. The tests were rough, but study hard and you'll succeed. The lectures were just derivations, so search for example problems on your own. He often gives “trick questions” and is confused when nobody gets them right.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Lectures were mostly following the textbook derivations for compressible flows. He would post the notes afterhand. Attendance not mandatory and not strictly necessary, however, it would take less time to show up than review it at home.

Homework followed lecture and exams followed homework with added conceptual questions from reading. Very fair.

Dr. G is very nice and has simple but sometimes boring lectures of just note taking and formula derivations. Textbook is not mandatory but it can be helpful with supplemental readings. The class is basically just two exams and a couple hws so not too demanding, just conceptually difficult.
